Episode details
Radio Scotland,17 Nov 2026,27 mins
Where does Scotland go after Swiss humiliation?
Scottish Football Podcast
Available for 29 days
A humbling defeat in Switzerland leaves Scotland with serious questions to answer. Has the national team gone backwards under Sebastian Pocognoli , does his system suit the players, and could the Scottish FA already be questioning its decision? Andy Burke is joined by Ryan Flynn and Craig Telfer to assess a worrying night. Plus, can Partick Thistle tighten their grip on the Championship, who are their biggest title rivals, and what happens when Ryan’s Arbroath take on Craig’s Stenhousemuir? And what should we expect from Scott Arfield at East Fife? 00:01:49 — Where has it gone wrong for Scotland? 00:06:06 — Does Pocognoli's system suit Scotland? 00:10:45 — Could the Scottish FA cut its losses? 00:15:11 — Can Partick Thistle take control of the title race? 00:21:01 — Arbroath v Stenhousemuir: the podcast derby 00:24:57 — What can Scott Arfield bring to East Fife?
